messages:
Maya: Hey, seeing lots of 503s on /v1/generate during spikes. Gateway is routing to fallback-small but client headers are not preserved so we lose tenant routing info. Example trace id: trace/0xabc
Liam: Hmm. Are we stripping X-Tenant? We added header-normalization in ingress last quarter.
Maya: yes, header preserved upstream but our fallback path clones request and removes some headers.
Sam: That's the bug. Fallback path used proxy copy with sanitizedHeaders list. Quick patch: pass through X-Tenant and X-RW-Affinity.
Toni: Do we want header-based affinity at all? It complicates routing. Alternative: per-tenant sticky sessions using quota tokens.
Rafa: Suggest policy: "header-affinity: passthrough" + "fallback: preserve-affinity" and add telemetry flag to note when fallback ignored.
Liam: Also circuit breaker kicks too early — current cb triggers at 5% 5xx/1m. Should be 10% or use adaptive window by qps.
Maya: Repro steps: run load test 500rps with cold kv-cache; cb flips in 30s and we immediately downshift to tiny-model causing latency spike.
Sam: Proposed config patch:
```
route /v1/generate {
  fallback-chain: [model-large, model-small]
  preserve-headers: ["X-Tenant","X-RW-Affinity"]
  cb: {threshold: 0.1, window: "2m", min-requests: 50}
}
```
Toni: Add a probe-only path so we can check small-model health without affecting traffic: probe_on_shadow: true
Rafa: Console UX: show "active fallback reason" in per-route detail and allow manual override to pin fallback or drain. Also surface per-tenant telemetry and last N fallbacks.
ops-bot: incident alert created INC-2026-78: gateway fallback storm — assigned to @maya
Maya: I'll open PR for fallback preserve and add telemetry flag. Will also file a postmortem if needed.
Liam: Also add metric: fallback_preserved_count and fallback_header_drop_count
Sam: Quick mitigation: set cb threshold to 0.2 and increase min-requests to 100 for next deploy :thumbsup:
Maya: Sounds good — planning a canary at 20% traffic in us-west for 15m
Toni: Don't forget to add unit tests for header passthrough
Rafa: And an alert if fallback rate > 3% for more than 5m
Maya: thanks, will update thread with PR link
